title: Puckworks dataset sidecar
description: Metadata sidecar (dataset.yaml) for one dataset folder in data/datasets/. Licensing rules: docs/PLAN.md §11 and data/datasets/README.md. Checked by `puckworks-tools validate-registry`, which also checks the data files against `columns`.

id.description: Equals the folder name: <first author><year>-<slug>, lower case, e.g. schmieder2023-centre-point.

citation.description: Full citation of the source the data come from.

doi.description: Bare DOI of the source, e.g. 10.3390/foods12152871.

licence.description: SPDX licence identifier of the data (e.g. CC-BY-4.0, CC0-1.0), or facts-cited when only facts (numbers) are taken, with citation, from a source without an open licence.

redistribution.description: allowed: the files may be bundled with the app; cite-only: only cited facts are bundled; forbidden: nothing from the source is bundled (e.g. non-commercial licences).

retrieved.description: Date the source was accessed, YYYY-MM-DD.

research_note_ref.description: Research-note section(s) that discuss the dataset, as in parameter records.

obtained.description: How the data were obtained: copied from tables, digitised from figures (tool, resolution), or received from the authors.

uncertainty.description: Transcription or digitisation uncertainty, and the statistical uncertainty reported by the source.

columns.description: Columns of every CSV file listed in `files`, in order.

units_column.description: Name of a string column that gives this column's units row by row.

required.description: Whether every row must have a value (default true).

path.description: Path relative to the dataset folder.
